title: Fractal Audio AM4

x_pc.additionalInfo: PC 0-103 selects AM4 presets A1-Z4. AM4 does not transmit or respond to bank select.

additionalInfo: Incoming MIDI CCs are globally assignable in SETUP > MIDI/Remote to functions including input volume, amp volume, output volume, tap tempo, tuner, four external controllers, additional preset and scene controls, and block bypass/channel switches. AM4 can transmit CC and PC messages via custom Scene MIDI or Send MIDI PC, receives MIDI clock, and does not transmit MIDI clock.
